parsed_json.up: Select exact IC50 activity rows for compounds tested against human hepatocyte growth factor receptor (CHEMBL3717). Join molecule_dictionary to activities, assays, target_dictionary, docs, and compound_records. Require compound_structures to be present (INNER JOIN) and require docs to have a pubmed_id or doi. Return columns compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Do not deduplicate; keep all activity rows. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
